From the owner
How long does a basement remodel take? Most basement remodels take 6 to 12 weeks of construction. A simple open rec room sits at the shorter end. Adding a bathroom, bedroom, or wet bar pushes it toward 12 weeks or more. Planning comes first. Design, material selections, and permits usually add a few weeks before work begins on site. The most common causes of delays are: - Moisture or water issues - Radon mitigation (common in PA basements) - Design changes after framing starts - Subcontractor scheduling gaps The best way to stay on schedule is to finalize your design, make your selections early, and get a written timeline before construction begins. Our latest blog has the full phase-by-phase breakdown and the questions to ask any contractor about timing.
